entries.title: Nozzle-fitted engine plumes
entries.body: Nozzle-fitted engine plumes: Terellian blue, Dantari orange-yellow and Marakan green, with smooth throttle response. Includes NPC traffic, mining drone controls and the local StarServer package.

entries.title: Starshatter Wars by Fractal Dev Games
entries.body: Install or update this build, then run T1 to check the new engine colors, nozzle fit and smooth throttle response.
